brief.goal: Add an email preview modal that shows full email content (subject, sender, body) and a link to open the email in Gmail in the browser
constraints: No component library - all UI is hand-built with inline styles
Must follow existing modal patterns (HealthCheckWizard, Convert-to-Task modal)
nonGoals: Mark as read functionality (Issue #21 - separate feature)
Convert to task functionality (Issue #19 - separate feature)
successCriteria: Click email opens preview modal with full content
Modal shows subject, sender, date, body
HTML email body renders correctly in sandboxed iframe
Open in Gmail button opens email in system browser
Modal shows account badge with color
Modal shows attachment names and sizes
Loading state while fetching email detail
Body HTML is sandboxed (no script execution)
Works for emails from all connected accounts
First open caches body for offline viewing

steps.prompt: Write a feature specification for the email preview modal feature. Include requirements, constraints, and measurable success criteria.
Break down the specification into an implementation plan with ordered, verifiable tasks.
Implement the next pending task from the plan. Follow test-driven practices.
Review the implementation against the specification and success criteria. Verify independently — you are the checker, not the maker.

specify.output: Created comprehensive feature specification for email preview modal with 11 functional requirements, 3 security requirements, and detailed technical design including IPC handlers, database migration, and component architecture.

plan.output: Created 7-task implementation plan covering database migration, Gmail API body fetch, IPC handler, preload types, React modal component, integration, and verification.

implement.output: Implemented all 7 tasks: database migration, Gmail API body fetch function, IPC handler, preload API exposure, EmailPreviewModal component, EmailList integration, and end-to-end verification.

converge.output: All 11 success criteria verified, no non-goal features introduced, implementation follows existing patterns. Sandboxed iframe correctly prevents script execution.
